statement: Change a setting, assignment or conversion in brush assets with "Activate Brush Asset"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
Remove or clear content in brush assets with "Delete Brush Asset"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in brush assets with "Edit Metadata"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Bring content into the document in brush assets with "Load Preview Image"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Bring content into the document in brush assets with "Revert Brush Asset"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.
Write document content to disk or pack it into the file in brush assets with "Save Brush Asset"; reading it back reproduces the same content, and failures leave the previous file intact.
Write document content to disk or pack it into the file in brush assets with "Save as Brush Asset"; reading it back reproduces the same content, and failures leave the previous file intact.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in brush assets with "Scale Sculpt/Paint Brush Size"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.
Use "Stencil Brush Control" in brush assets; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.
Use "Image Aspect" in brush assets; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in brush assets with "Reset Transform"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
